`final class SignedDistance`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.tool.msdf.geometry` · **Module:** `tool-msdf` · **Source:** [SignedDistance.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/msdf/src/main/java/dev/joid/tool/msdf/geometry/SignedDistance.java)

A signed distance from a point to an edge, with its orthogonality to break ties.
